title: Better value at $15
text:
Ordered the Barkbox on sale at $15. Definitely worth that but not $30. There were 2 toys, not very durable. Both got chewed up by the end of the day. 2 small bags of treats and one "power bar".

My 2 dogs really had fun opening the box. Not there favorite treats but they ate them.

Would not order this box monthly for $30. You could go to the grocery store and bring home way more for $30.
label: negative
